video_title: Wolves GM says Anthony Edwards can 'go down as one of the best ever'

quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Connelly on evaluating roster changes and team health
quotes.excerpt: we'd only make a deal if we thought it would make us better not just here and now
quotes.quote: We were disappointed we weren't the best version of ourselves last year in the playoffs, but we also know how high the bar is in the Western Conference. We always said we'd only make a deal if we thought it would make us better, not just here and now for the long term. We think the age appropriateness of Rudy with this young core will fit very well. We got off a bunch of really good players who are having great years elsewhere, but we're very aware of what we have to overcome and how difficult that task will be and we think we're more prepared than ever.

quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' role as the team's central figure
quotes.excerpt: he's an elite player and certainly our leader
quotes.quote: He's an elite player and certainly our leader. We think he's a guy that when it's all said and done can go down as one of the best to ever do it. So with that comes tremendous responsibility, but the wins and losses will be a collective effort and when we succeed, we succeed together and when we fail, we fail together. Another fantastic summer for Anthony. He was very excited about the moves we made. He feels like we're primed to make another jump or two and he's a guy that really feeds off competitiveness.

quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Dante's injury recovery and outlook for the season
quotes.excerpt: we're cautious and optimistic that we're going to see Dante this season
quotes.quote: Dante looks great. As you guys all know, Dante attacks everything like he attacks the court. I thought our medical staff and his agents did a great job of quickly getting it addressed. He was under the knife 24 hours after the surgery. He looks as good as we'd hoped. We don't want to put any added pressure on him, but we're cautious and optimistic that we're going to see Dante this season and we know how much he brings to our team.

quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' potential to become an elite two-way player
quotes.excerpt: Anthony's best chance to be the best player in the world is to be the best two-way player
quotes.quote: Anthony's best chance to be the best player in the world is to be the best two-way player in the world. His competition is so good and so talented to be in that mix of the top four or five guys to be an MVP candidate. I think he'd be the first to tell you at times last year, and some of it was our fault, we put him in positions where he had to do so much offensively. We think a lot of the ball-handling stuff will be out of his hands now with more traditional point guards next to him. But he's got to be a two-way player. He's got to be a lead on both ends.

quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Development and expectations for Naz Reid
quotes.excerpt: there's not a harder working guy on our team
quotes.quote: Extremely excited about Naz's development. When he was given an opportunity last year, he produced at a high level. There's not a harder working guy on our team and we think his best basketball is in front of him and we think he's ready to make an impact this season.

quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Conley's impact on team offense and spacing
quotes.excerpt: there's very few guys in the NBA that can make offense easier for others
quotes.quote: There's very few guys in the NBA that can make offense easier for others. There's a lot of good offensive players, but guys who actually create easier shots than you'd otherwise produce. I think Mike is a part of a very small group of guys that is a natural, instinctive playmaker and with that, I think you'll see guys return to more traditional roles and we're hopeful that he'll perhaps get them easier offense. Can we play a bit faster? We've had our challenges finding Rudy at times as a lob threat. Mike is a lob threat. Anthony is one of the best catch-and-shoot guys in the world.
